description: Five comparators sharing one positive and one negative rail.

inputs.text: Sets the voltage every output takes while its non-inverting input is the higher of the two; with nothing patched in, the high value of the digital voltage range is used.
Sets the voltage every output takes while its non-inverting input is not the higher of the two; with nothing patched in, the low value of the digital voltage range is used.
The non-inverting input of that comparator; while it is above the inverting input, that output takes the + rail voltage.
The inverting input of that comparator; while it is at or above the non-inverting input, that output takes the - rail voltage.

outputs.text: Takes the + rail voltage while that comparator's non-inverting input is above its inverting input, and the - rail voltage otherwise; it is driven only while both inputs are patched.

menu: Digital Voltage Range — a submenu of 0-1V, 0-5V, 0-10V, -5V to 5V and -10V to 10V, setting the pair of voltages used for low and high; an input reads high above the midpoint of the pair.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
